title: The customer page shows the reps with or without an address
custom_preconds:
Preconditions

  • Sign in as an Admin at the test location.
  • Have two active staff members at the test location with their "Sales Representative" switch on: sales rep A and sales rep B.
  • Use customer A, with no address and no Sales Representative assigned.
  • Use customer B, with no address, "Sales Representative - Service Labor" set to sales rep A and "Sales Representative - Service Parts" set to sales rep B.
  • Open the Customers page in a desktop browser at least 1024 pixels wide.
  • If you cannot set up any of the above, mark this test Blocked: "setup not done".
custom_steps:
1. Open customer A's page.
  2. Open customer B's page.
custom_expected:
Expected Result

Step 1:

  • The page shows "Sales Representative" reading "Unassigned" (not "N/A"), even though the customer has no address.

Step 2:

  • The page shows "Sales Representative - Service Labor" sales rep A, then "Sales Representative - Service Parts" sales rep B.

Exact quotes from the source (for reproducibility)

From: PRD "Splitting Sales Representatives", Confluence 919928833, version 11 (21 Oct 2026, Chris Ward), read 22 Oct 2026 · Epic SV-10890, story SV-11268 (Story 4, Give a customer default representatives)

  • S4-R19: “The customer page shows the representatives with the window's labels, in the window's order: "Sales Representative" or "Sales Representative - Service Labor", then "Sales Representative - Service Parts" when added, then "Sales Representative - Part Sales" when added. An empty one reads "Unassigned". The Sales Representative rows show on every customer, whether or not the customer has an address. The other fields on the page keep today's rule of showing only when the customer has an address.”
  • S4-E1: “On release day every existing customer has the one "Sales Representative" field, with no Service Parts or Part Sales field, and keeps its one representative, so the customer page and every invoice read exactly as before, except that an empty field reads "Unassigned" instead of "N/A". About 10 customers whose representative is no longer a user of the shop are the exception: they read "Unassigned".”

The build is not yet available to check this case against.

Claude design canvas "Splitting Sales Representatives" (https://claude.ai/artifact/8MHqwyffAYtqZ6EccS5RUm), page 2 (cited by the story), export read 19 Oct 2026, used for on-screen labels; the look itself is checked in the "Design — how it looks" cases.
